title: [IMP-1] The live client-relay protocol has no message set
description: Review finding IMP-1: The live client-relay protocol has no message set (lens IMP). Location: spec/11-transport.md:36, :54-64, :80-135, :398-407. Fix: As proposed. Only ClientHello, RelayHello, AdmissionChallenge and AdmissionProof exist (11:80-133). No grep hit anywhere for a subscribe, publish, deliver, ack or pin message. "channel ID prefix" (11:36) does not appear in the frame structure (11:59). §11.8.8 assigns push registration and MLS handshake to the live stream only, so the gap blocks those features too. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: Decision A implemented: spec/11-transport.md §11.4 "Frame Format and Message Set" CDDL (ClientHello/RelayHello/AdmissionChallenge/AdmissionProof/Subscribe/Unsubscribe/Publish/Deliver/Ack/Error/PinInstruction/PushRegister), identical over WebTransport and WebSocket; §11.8.8 JMAP for history only
